selection_rule: First service day after11/11 with a completed saved archive. Reject only missing/unreadable/wrong-date source, record reason. Never choose by model score. Retain partial-route days and label coverage rather than removing unfavorable results.
source_quality_rules: Verify export completion, provider/capture timestamps, saved route identifiers, stop sequence mapping and checksums before computing errors.
Report route fetch-attempt coverage in every15minute peak bin independently of active vehicle counts; API-error/missing bins lower coverage, not automatically mean no buses.
Deduplicate identical route/vehicle/provider-time keys and preserve same-vehicle/day dependence.
Keep existing detected-stop60m/previous-provider120sec interval definition and report exclusions for >1800sec travel, <15sec/>3600sec passage gaps; no new outcome-based filters.
If fewer routes/cells are available, show denominators and all usable rows; do not search for a different higher-scoring day.
primary_metrics: Adjacent detected-stop time MAE/bias and mapped/unsupported counts vs preserved R10
Stop-passage headway median MAE vs official nominal, plus distribution diagnostics and truncation counts
Ordinal grade multiclass Brier and paired transition Brier vs carrying last known grade
Full-flag availability as separate known/unknown binary scope, never seats
Only when aligned new observations exist: minute-window physical queue error, individual wait, cumulative wait and station/hub total time
queue_and_individual_truth_missing_actio: NOT_EVALUABLE; city labels cannot supply shuttle queue or personal-wait truth
after_evaluation_rule: Mark date consumed; never refit and call that same date pristine. Reserve a later completed date for the next candidate.
